tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM] We typically manage Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn, and recommend the right mix for your business during your strategy session.

tabs.tab_title: Do I have to create the content myself?
tabs.tab_content: No. Our team plans, creates and publishes your content. We may ask for photos or quick videos from your business, because real images of your team and work perform best.

tabs.tab_title: How long until I see results?
tabs.tab_content: Most businesses see engagement improve within the first month. Leads from social typically build over the first 60 to 90 days as the calendar, automations and campaigns work together.

tabs.tab_title: Will you respond to comments and messages?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Community management is included, and DM automations handle common questions and lead capture around the clock.

tabs.tab_title: Can I buy Social Media on its own?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every service is delivered as part of a FirstSearch partnership, because social media works best alongside the rest of your marketing system. Your plan includes every service your business needs for one fixed monthly retainer.
